Delivered: **candidate_16** (viewer: `candidate_16/viewer.html`, source model `candidate_16/source_model.json`).

## Building reconstructed
Single storey, 10 m (x, west–east) × 20 m (y, south–north), floor z=0, ceiling 4.5 m. 8 spaces, 54 boundaries, 21 openings, 10 door connections:

- **Spaces**: N-room (full-width north, y 15.93–20), NW-meeting (y 12.99–15.93), W-office (y 8.05–12.99), SW-conference (y 0–8.05) down the west side; corridor-lobby spine (x 4.20–5.73) from the north wall to the L-shaped wall-E closure at y 3.43, opening east into the lobby; NE-cabinet (1.69 m deep), E-meeting (y 8.05–14.24) and SE-office (L-shaped, with the south vestibule) on the east side.
- **Doors**: 3 exterior — D-N-entry, D-S, D-E (all 1.6 m, z 0.2–2.6). 7 interior — D-B1, D-L1, D-L2, D-CONF, D-R2, D-R3, D-BR (assumed z 0–2.1).
- **Windows**: 11 — four 4800 mm (W-N1, W-E3, W-W5, z 1–3.4), six 1500 mm and one 1180 mm (z 1–2.8), each on its observed wall.

## Observed
- All walls and dividers from the plan's drawn line pairs; every opening placed from its own jamb/frame marks and dimension segments (plan calibration 27.47 mm/px from the 10000/20000 chains; draft_002 ended with 0 drawing_differences after the wall-x458 and D-B1 corrections).
- All 14 exterior opening heights read from per-facade dimension chains on the four elevations (ordinary windows 1700+1800+1000; large windows 1100+2400+1000; doors 1900+2400+200 from the 4500 wall top). All 14 are **located claims** on the delivered candidate: 5 applied (North/South) and 9 confirmed with per-opening elevation crops under registered East/West calibrations; calibrated overlays align projected openings with the drawn ink on all four facades. Facade window counts match observations (N 1, S 2, E 3, W 5).

## Assumed (explicit in saved notes)
- Interior door heights 0–2.1 m (no interior elevation supplied).
- Interior partitions on line-pair midplanes; drawn 240 mm thicknesses not modelled.
- All 8 room uses inferred (no printed labels): office ×3, meeting/conference ×3, corridor, storage (NE-cabinet).

## Left unexamined / limitations
- Door swing directions visible in the plan but leaf state not modelled.
- All pixel-to-world and elevation calibrations are caller-supplied arithmetic, not independently verified; a returned image is not proof of correct interpretation.
- "distinct_width_on_facade" informational flags on W-E3/W-W5 (each has its own chain, so no height transfer was involved); drawing fidelity formally "not_evaluated" by the tooling, differences were resolved manually to 0 on the final draft.
